# Alan Joseph Monichan

> Software Developer, Data Analyst, and AI & BI Specialist based in Surathkal, India. Builds full-stack web apps, cross-platform mobile apps, AI/RAG pipelines, and data analytics dashboards. Currently a Junior Project Assistant at the Department of CSD, NITK Surathkal, and a freelance full-stack developer at Nasscript Software Innovations.

## Profile

- MCA (Master of Computer Applications), Mar Athanasios College, MG University, 2023–2025.
- BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications), Devamatha College, Kannur University, 2020–2023.
- Core skills: React.js, Django, React Native, Expo, Python, Power BI/DAX, ETL automation, LLM fine-tuning (Mistral, Gemini), RAG pipelines, OpenCV/TensorFlow computer vision, embedded C/C++ for IoT, Firebase, Node.js, Three.js.
- Delivered data-driven solutions for Tata Motors and Government of Goa initiatives.

## Client & Personal Websites (featured on the Projects section of the home page)

- [Kripa Enterprises](https://furniture-shop-website-zeta.vercel.app/): Marketing website for a teak wood furniture and interiors brand, built around full-bleed architectural photography.
- [Omnia](https://omnia-premium-fashion-store.vercel.app/): A luxury fashion e-commerce landing experience with a full-bleed lookbook hero and seasonal collection merchandising. Built with React and Vite.
